name: French Toast with Bacon and Fresh Fruit
ingredients:
60 slices | Texas toast or thick-sliced bread, 2 per person
2 qt | Liquid eggs
1.5 qt | Whole milk
1 cup | Granulated sugar
1/4 cup | Vanilla extract
2 Tbsp | Ground cinnamon
3 lb | Bacon
8 lb | Fresh fruit
1 qt | Pancake syrup
As needed | Butter or pan spray
method:
1. Cook the bacon on sheet pans or the flat top until crisp. Drain and hold warm.
2. Whisk the liquid eggs, milk, sugar, vanilla, and cinnamon until evenly blended.
3. Dip the bread briefly in the batter and cook on a buttered flat top until golden on both sides and the egg mixture is fully set.
4. Cut or portion the fresh fruit while the French toast cooks.
5. Serve two slices of French toast per person with bacon, fruit, butter, and syrup.
notes: Cook the bacon first and run French toast continuously on the flat top. Do not soak the bread long enough for it to fall apart.

name: Bulgogi Beef with Fried Rice and Steamed Broccoli
ingredients:
10 lb | Beef, thinly sliced
1 batch | Prepared bulgogi sauce, separate appendix recipe
4 lb dry | Rice, cooked and chilled
2 qt | Liquid eggs
3 lb | Frozen mixed vegetables
1.5 cups | Soy sauce
2 No. 10 cans | Broccoli, drained, or 8 lb frozen broccoli
As needed | Oil, garlic, black pepper, and sliced green onion
method:
1. Marinate the sliced beef with enough bulgogi sauce to coat it. Reserve clean sauce for finishing.
2. Cook the beef quickly in batches on the flat top until browned and fully cooked. Add reserved sauce and glaze briefly.
3. Scramble the liquid eggs and set aside. Stir-fry the mixed vegetables, add the cold rice, and cook over high heat.
4. Add soy sauce, eggs, garlic, and black pepper to the rice. Toss until heated to 165°F.
5. Steam or heat the broccoli to 165°F. Serve the bulgogi with fried rice and broccoli.
notes: Cook and chill the rice before service. Slice the beef thinly and cook in small batches so it browns instead of steaming.

name: Breakfast Burritos with Salsa and Fresh Fruit
ingredients:
30 | Large flour tortillas
2 qt | Liquid eggs
8 lb | Potatoes, small dice or par-cooked
3 lb | Bacon, cooked and chopped
2 lb | Shredded cheese
1.5 qt | Salsa
8 lb | Fresh fruit
As needed | Oil, pan spray, salt, black pepper, and paprika
method:
1. Cook the potatoes on the flat top with oil and seasoning until browned and tender.
2. Cook the bacon until crisp and drain. Scramble the liquid eggs in batches and keep them soft.
3. Warm the tortillas. Divide the potatoes, eggs, bacon, and cheese among 30 tortillas.
4. Roll tightly and place seam-side down in covered hotel pans. Hold only briefly.
5. Serve one burrito per person with salsa and fresh fruit.
notes: Use par-cooked potatoes to stay inside the 30-minute window. Assemble close to service so the tortillas stay soft without becoming wet.

name: Taco Tuesday with Spanish Rice Salad and Taco Toppings
ingredients:
10 lb | Ground beef or prepared taco meat
6 oz | Taco seasoning
2 cups | Water
60 | Taco shells or small tortillas
4 lb dry | Rice
As needed | Tomato sauce, stock, and seasoning for Spanish rice
3 lb | Shredded cheese
2 lb | Shredded lettuce
3 lb | Diced tomatoes
2 qt | Salsa
2 large bowls | Green salad with dressing
method:
1. Start the Spanish rice according to the house method. Prepare the salad and taco toppings.
2. Brown the ground beef on the flat top or in a tilt skillet. Drain excess fat.
3. Add the taco seasoning and water. Simmer until evenly seasoned and the liquid reduces.
4. Warm the taco shells or tortillas and set out the meat, cheese, lettuce, tomatoes, and salsa.
5. Plan on two tacos per person. Hold the taco meat and rice at 135°F or above.
notes: Start the rice first. Keep the taco setup simple and replenish toppings in small batches to protect quality and temperature.

name: Sausage Egg and Cheese Biscuits with Home Fries and Fruit
ingredients:
30 | Biscuits, baked and split
2 qt | Liquid eggs
30 patties | Breakfast sausage
30 slices | American or provolone cheese
8 lb | Potatoes, small dice or par-cooked
1.5 lb | Diced onions
8 lb | Fresh fruit
As needed | Oil, butter, pan spray, salt, black pepper, and paprika
method:
1. Bake or warm the biscuits. Cook the sausage patties to 155°F and hold warm.
2. Cook the potatoes and onions on the flat top with oil and seasoning until browned and tender.
3. Cook the liquid eggs in greased hotel pans or in batches on the flat top and divide into 30 portions.
4. Build each biscuit with sausage, egg, and one slice of cheese. Heat briefly to melt the cheese.
5. Serve one sandwich per person with home fries and fruit.
notes: Run sausage, potatoes, and eggs at the same time. Use par-cooked potatoes and avoid assembling the biscuits too early.

name: Chicken Parmesan Subs with Pasta Salad and Green Salad
ingredients:
36 | Breaded chicken portions
2 gal | Hot house marinara
3 lb | Shredded mozzarella or provolone
30 | Sub rolls or portions of Tomaro’s bread
6 lb dry | Short pasta for pasta salad
2 qt | Italian dressing
4 lb | Mixed vegetables for pasta salad
2 large bowls | Green salad with dressing
1 lb | Grated Romano
method:
1. Bake or fry the breaded chicken until crisp and heated to 165°F.
2. Cook the pasta, cool it promptly, and toss with Italian dressing and vegetables.
3. Warm the marinara. Place chicken in the rolls, top with controlled portions of sauce and cheese, and heat until melted.
4. Prepare the green salad and hold cold at 41°F or below.
5. Serve one chicken Parmesan sub per person with pasta salad and green salad.
notes: Prepare and chill the pasta salad ahead when possible. Add marinara just before service so the bread and chicken stay crisp.

name: Grilled Cheese with Cream of Tomato Soup
ingredients:
60 slices | Sandwich bread
60 slices | American cheese, 2 per sandwich
1 lb | Soft butter
2.5 gal | Prepared cream of tomato soup
As needed | Milk or water to adjust soup
As needed | Salt and black pepper
method:
1. Heat the tomato soup to 165°F, stirring often. Adjust the consistency with milk or water if needed.
2. Butter one side of each bread slice. Place two cheese slices between the unbuttered sides.
3. Cook the sandwiches on the flat top in batches until golden on both sides and the cheese is melted.
4. Cut each sandwich in half and hold only briefly so the bread stays crisp.
5. Serve one grilled-cheese sandwich per person with about 10 ounces of soup.
notes: Heat the soup first, then cook the sandwiches as close to service as possible. Do not stack hot sandwiches tightly or they will steam.

name: Chicken Piccata with Lemon Rosemary Risotto Green Salad and Garlic Bread
ingredients:
36 portions | Chicken breast cutlets
As needed | Flour, salt, black pepper, and oil for sautéing
1 batch | Prepared chicken piccata sauce, separate appendix recipe
1 batch | Lemon rosemary risotto, separate appendix recipe
2 large bowls | Green salad with dressing
2 full pans | Garlic bread
method:
1. Season the chicken lightly and dredge it in flour. Shake off all excess flour.
2. Sauté the cutlets in batches until browned and they reach 165°F. Transfer to hotel pans.
3. Prepare the lemon rosemary risotto while the chicken cooks. Keep it loose with hot stock.
4. Heat the piccata sauce and spoon it over the chicken just before service. Heat the garlic bread and prepare the salad.
5. Serve one cutlet per person with risotto, green salad, and garlic bread.
notes: Produce the piccata sauce and risotto from their appendix recipes. Start the risotto first, cook the chicken in batches, and sauce the chicken just before service.

name: Biscuits with Sausage Gravy and Scrambled Eggs
ingredients:
30 | Biscuits, baked
4 lb | Breakfast sausage
12 oz | Butter
12 oz | All-purpose flour
1.5 gal | Whole milk, warm
2 qt | Liquid eggs
As needed | Pan spray, salt, and black pepper
method:
1. Bake or warm the biscuits. Brown the sausage in a heavy pot or tilt skillet and keep the rendered fat.
2. Add the butter if needed, stir in the flour, and cook 3 to 4 minutes. Gradually whisk in the warm milk.
3. Simmer the gravy 8 to 10 minutes, stirring, until smooth and the flour taste is gone. Season generously with black pepper.
4. Cook the liquid eggs in greased hotel pans or in batches on the flat top until set.
5. Serve one biscuit per person with sausage gravy and scrambled eggs.
notes: Start the gravy first so it has enough time to simmer. Keep extra warm milk available because sausage gravy thickens while holding.

name: Fish Sandwiches with French Fries and Salad
ingredients:
36 | Frozen fish patties
30 | Sandwich buns
30 slices | American cheese, optional
1.5 qt | Prepared tartar sauce
12 lb | Frozen French fries
2 large bowls | Green salad with dressing
As needed | Lettuce, pickles, and fry seasoning
method:
1. Bake or fry the fish patties according to the product directions until crisp and heated to 165°F.
2. Warm the buns briefly. Add cheese to the fish during the final heating if using.
3. Fry the French fries in batches and season immediately.
4. Prepare the salad and keep it at 41°F or below.
5. Build one fish sandwich per person and serve with fries, salad, tartar sauce, lettuce, and pickles.
notes: Use the fish patties from Freezer 1. Time the last fish and fry batches close to service and keep crisp items uncovered or lightly vented.

name: Pancakes with Sausage and Fresh Fruit
ingredients:
90 | Medium pancakes, 2 per person
1.8 gal | Prepared house pancake batter
55 patties | Breakfast sausage
12 lb | Fresh fruit
1.5 qt | Pancake syrup
12 oz | Butter
As needed | Pan spray
method:
1. Cook the sausage on sheet pans or the flat top until it reaches 155°F. Drain and hold warm.
2. Cook the pancakes in batches on a greased flat top, making about 90 medium pancakes.
3. Cut or portion the fresh fruit while the pancakes and sausage cook.
4. Hold pancakes covered only briefly so they remain soft without becoming wet.
5. Serve two pancakes per person with sausage, fresh fruit, butter, and syrup.
notes: Run the sausage in the oven while pancakes cook on the flat top. Use 1.5 times the 1.2-gallon house pancake batter recipe.

name: Baked Rigatoni with Meat Sauce Garlic Bread and Salad
ingredients:
8 lb dry | Rigatoni
3 gal | Hot house meat sauce
4 lb | Shredded mozzarella
1.5 lb | Grated Romano
3 full pans | Garlic bread
3 large bowls | Green salad with dressing
As needed | Oil, salt, and black pepper
method:
1. Bring pasta water to a boil. Cook the rigatoni just short of al dente and drain well.
2. Combine the pasta with enough hot meat sauce to coat it. Divide among greased full hotel pans.
3. Top with mozzarella and Romano. Bake at high heat until bubbling and the center reaches 165°F.
4. Heat the garlic bread and prepare the salad. Hold the salad at 41°F or below.
5. Hold the baked rigatoni at 135°F or above and serve with garlic bread and salad.
notes: Use hot meat sauce and slightly undercook the rigatoni so the finished pasta does not become soft. Start the pasta water immediately.

name: Breakfast Casserole with Toast and Fresh Fruit
ingredients:
3 qt | Liquid eggs
12 lb | Frozen hash browns or par-cooked diced potatoes
5 lb | Bacon, cooked and chopped
4 lb | Shredded cheese
2 lb | Diced onions
2 qt | Whole milk
45 slices | Toast
12 lb | Fresh fruit
As needed | Pan spray, salt, and black pepper
method:
1. Heat the oven to 375°F and grease full hotel pans. Spread the potatoes, bacon, onions, and cheese evenly in the pans.
2. Whisk the liquid eggs, milk, salt, and pepper. Pour evenly over the filled pans.
3. Bake until the center is set and reaches 165°F, rotating pans if needed.
4. Toast the bread and portion the fresh fruit while the casserole cooks.
5. Cut into 45 portions and hold at 135°F or above until service.
notes: Use shallow layers across multiple pans to meet the 30-minute target. Par-cooked potatoes and pre-cooked bacon are required for fast execution.

name: Chicken and Biscuits with Mashed Potatoes and Green Salad
ingredients:
1 batch | Chicken pot pie filling, separate appendix recipe
48 | Par-baked biscuits
15 lb | Prepared mashed potatoes
3 large bowls | Green salad with dressing
As needed | Butter, salt, and black pepper
method:
1. Prepare the chicken pot pie filling and divide it between two full 2-inch hotel pans. Heat to 165°F.
2. Arrange 24 par-baked biscuits over each pan of hot filling.
3. Bake until the biscuits are browned and fully baked and the filling is bubbling.
4. Heat the mashed potatoes to 165°F and finish with butter and seasoning. Prepare the salad and hold at 41°F or below.
5. Serve one biscuit with chicken filling per person, with extra biscuits available, mashed potatoes, and salad.
notes: This recipe uses two plats of 24 par-baked biscuits and the tested 3-gallon-stock chicken pot pie filling. Keep the salad cold and hold the hot food at 135°F or above.

name: Bacon Egg and Cheese Breakfast Sandwiches with Hash Browns
ingredients:
30 | Sandwich rolls, English muffins, or available breakfast bread
2 qt | Liquid eggs
3 lb | Bacon
30 slices | American or provolone cheese
30 | Hash brown patties
As needed | Butter or pan spray, salt, and black pepper
method:
1. Cook the bacon on sheet pans or the flat top until crisp. Drain and hold warm.
2. Bake or fry the hash brown patties according to the package directions.
3. Cook the liquid eggs in batches on the flat top or in greased hotel pans. Season lightly and portion into 30 servings.
4. Warm the bread. Build each sandwich with egg, bacon, and one slice of cheese.
5. Hold covered only long enough to melt the cheese. Serve one sandwich and one hash brown per person.
notes: Cook the bacon, eggs, and hash browns at the same time. Do not hold the assembled sandwiches long enough for the bread to become soggy.

name: BBQ Pulled Chicken Sandwiches with Baked Beans
ingredients:
8 lb | Cooked pulled or chopped chicken
2 qt | BBQ sauce
30 | Sandwich buns
1.5 gal | Prepared baked beans
1 lb | Diced onion, optional
As needed | Salt, black pepper, and butter or oil
method:
1. Combine the cooked chicken and BBQ sauce in a rondeau or hotel pan. Heat to 165°F, stirring as needed.
2. Heat the baked beans to at least 165°F for reheating. Add diced onion if desired.
3. Warm the buns briefly without drying them out.
4. Portion about 4 ounces of BBQ chicken onto each bun and serve with baked beans.
notes: This is a good use for safe cooked chicken or chicken trim. Keep the sauce controlled so the sandwiches do not become wet.

name: French Toast Sticks with Scrambled Eggs
ingredients:
42 | Slices of bread, about 4 per person
2 qt | Liquid eggs
1 qt | Milk
2 Tbsp | Vanilla Extract
1 Tbsp | Cinnamon
1 tsp | Salt
method:
- Cut 40–44 slices of bread into three thick sticks each. This gives you approximately 120–132 sticks.
- In a large container, whisk together:
- 1 quart liquid eggs
- 1 quart milk
- ½ cup sugar
- 2 tablespoons vanilla extract
- 1 tablespoon cinnamon
- 1 teaspoon salt
- Preheat the flat-top to 350°F and coat it lightly with butter or pan spray.
- Whisk the batter again before each batch because the cinnamon will settle.
- Dip the bread sticks briefly in the batter. Coat all sides, but don’t let them soak.
- Place them on the hot flat-top without crowding. Cook for approximately 2–3 minutes per side, turning until evenly golden brown.
- Check that the centers are cooked and the egg mixture has set. French toast containing egg should reach 160°F.
- Transfer the finished sticks to shallow hotel pans. Hold covered loosely at 135°F or above so they stay warm without steaming excessively.
- Serve four sticks per person with syrup. Whisk and mix additional batter only if the first batch runs short.
notes: Cut each slice of bread into three thick sticks. Whisk the batter between batches because the cinnamon will settle. Dip the bread quickly without soaking, cook in batches on the flat-top, and hold loosely covered so the sticks stay warm without becoming soggy.

name: Taco Tuesday
ingredients:
10 lb | Ground beef or prepared taco meat
6 oz | Taco seasoning
2 cups | Water
60 | Taco shells or small tortillas
3 lb | Shredded cheese
2 lb | Shredded lettuce
3 lb | Diced tomatoes
2 qt | Salsa
1 | full basket Tortilla chips
method:
1. Brown the ground beef on the flat top or in a tilt skillet. Drain excess fat.
2. Add taco seasoning and water. Simmer until the meat is evenly seasoned and the liquid has reduced.
3. Warm the tortillas or taco shells.
4. Set up the meat, lettuce, tomatoes, cheese, salsa, and chips as a taco bar.
5. Plan on two tacos per person. Hold the taco meat at 135°F or above.
notes: Keep the standard Taco Tuesday setup simple. Use safe available toppings, but avoid adding extra items that slow down the crew.

name: Grilled Cheese Sandwiches with Tomato Soup
ingredients:
60 slices | Sandwich bread
60 slices | American cheese
1.5 lb | Soft butter
2.5 gal | Prepared tomato soup
As needed | Salt and black pepper
method:
1. Heat the tomato soup to 165°F if reheating. Stir often and adjust the seasoning.
2. Butter one side of each slice of bread. Build 30 sandwiches with two slices of cheese each.
3. Cook the sandwiches on the flat top in batches until both sides are browned and the cheese is melted.
4. Cut each sandwich in half and serve with about 10 ounces of tomato soup.
notes: Start the soup first and cook the sandwiches while it heats. Hold finished sandwiches only briefly so they stay crisp.

name: Chicken and Waffles with Seasoned Potato Wedges
ingredients:
60 | Breaded chicken tenders, about 2 per person
30 | Belgian waffles or 60 waffle halves
12 lb | Cut potato wedges
1.5 qt | Pancake syrup
8 oz | Butter
As needed | Pan spray and powdered sugar, optional
method:
1. Start the potato wedges in the oven immediately and cook until browned and crisp.
2. Fry or bake the chicken tenders until crisp and the chicken reaches 165°F.
3. Heat the waffles in the oven or toaster. Do not stack them too early or they will steam.
4. Serve one waffle with two chicken tenders, potato wedges, butter, and syrup.
notes: This is the higher-cost meal. Use portion control on the chicken and waffles. Run the chicken, waffles, and wedges at the same time.

name: Hot Dogs with Hot Dog Chili and French Fries
ingredients:
36 | Hot dogs
36 | Hot dog buns
10 lb | Frozen French fries
3 lb | Ground beef for chili
1 lb | Yellow onion, finely diced
1 qt | Tomato sauce
2 cups | Ketchup
1 qt | Water or beef stock
3 oz | Chili powder
1 oz each | Ground cumin and paprika
2 tbsp each | Garlic powder and onion powder
2 tbsp each | Brown sugar and Worcestershire sauce
As needed | Salt, black pepper, mustard, and diced onion
method:
1. For the hot dog chili, combine the ground beef and water or stock in a pot or rondeau. Break the meat into a very fine texture while it comes to a simmer.
2. Add the onion, tomato sauce, ketchup, chili powder, cumin, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, brown sugar, and Worcestershire sauce.
3. Simmer uncovered for 15 to 20 minutes, stirring often, until thick enough to spoon onto a hot dog. Season with salt and pepper.
4. Cook the hot dogs on the flat top, grill, or in simmering water. Warm the buns.
5. Fry the French fries in batches. Serve one hot dog per person, with extras available, and offer chili, mustard, and onion.
notes: The chili makes about 2.5 quarts. Start it first. A fine beef texture and a short uncovered simmer give it the right hot dog chili consistency.

name: Italian Subs with Soppressata Capicola and Salami
ingredients:
30 | Hoagie rolls or portions of Tomaro’s bread
1.5 lb | Soppressata, thinly sliced
1.5 lb | Capicola, thinly sliced
1.5 lb | Salami, thinly sliced
2 lb | Provolone cheese
2 lb | Shredded lettuce
3 lb | Sliced tomatoes
1 lb | Thinly sliced onion
1 qt | Banana peppers or pepper rings
1 qt | Italian dressing
30 bags | or 3 lb Potato chips
method:
1. Split the rolls or portion the Tomaro’s bread. Lay the bread out in assembly-line order.
2. Divide the soppressata, capicola, and salami evenly among 30 sandwiches. Add provolone.
3. Add lettuce, tomato, onion, and banana peppers.
4. Dress lightly just before service so the bread does not become soggy.
5. Cut the subs in half and serve with chips.
notes: Use about 2.4 ounces of combined meat per sandwich. Build close to service and keep the sliced meats and cheese at 41°F or below.

name: Pancakes with Bacon
ingredients:
60 | Medium pancakes, about 2 per person
1.5 gal | Prepared pancake batter
4 lb | Bacon
1 qt | Pancake syrup
8 oz | Butter
As needed | Pan spray
method:
1. Cook the bacon on sheet pans or the flat top until crisp. Drain and hold warm.
2. Cook the pancakes in batches on a greased flat top, making about 60 medium pancakes.
3. Hold the pancakes covered only briefly so they stay soft without becoming wet.
4. Serve two pancakes and a portion of bacon per person with butter and syrup.
notes: Run bacon in the oven while pancakes cook on the flat top. Use the house pancake batter when available.

name: Sweet and Sour Chicken with Fried Rice
ingredients:
10 lb | Small diced chicken
2 No. 10 cans | Pineapple chunks, drained; reserve 1.5 quarts juice
3 lb peppers and 2 lb onions | Bell peppers and onions, large dice
4 lb dry | Rice, cooked and chilled before service
2 qt vegetables and 12 eggs | Mixed vegetables and eggs for fried rice
2.5 cups total | Soy sauce, divided between fried rice and sauce
As needed | Oil, salt, black pepper, and garlic
1.5 qt juice; 3 cups each sugar and vinegar; 2 cups ketchup | Sweet-and-sour sauce base
1 cup each | Cornstarch and cold water for slurry
method:
1. Cook the chicken until 165°F. Keep it separate from the sauce until shortly before service.
2. For the sauce, combine pineapple juice, sugar, vinegar, ketchup, and soy sauce. Bring to a boil. Whisk cornstarch with cold water, add gradually, and simmer until glossy and thick.
3. Sauté the peppers and onions until crisp-tender. Add the pineapple, then fold in enough sweet-and-sour sauce to coat.
4. For the fried rice, heat oil on the flat top. Scramble the eggs, add vegetables and cold cooked rice, then season with soy sauce, garlic, and black pepper.
5. Toss the hot chicken with the sauce mixture just before serving. Serve over or beside the fried rice.
notes: Cook and chill the rice ahead so the full meal can be finished in 30 minutes.

name: Breakfast Bowls with Eggs Bacon Potatoes and Cheese
ingredients:
3 qt | Liquid eggs
5 lb | Bacon
12 lb | Potatoes, small dice or par-cooked
2 lb | Diced onions
3 lb | Shredded cheese
45 slices | Toast
As needed | Oil, butter, pan spray, salt, black pepper, and paprika
method:
1. Cook the bacon on sheet pans until crisp. Drain and chop.
2. Cook the potatoes and onions on the flat top with oil. Season with salt, pepper, and paprika. Use par-cooked potatoes if available.
3. Cook the liquid eggs in greased hotel pans or batches on the flat top. Finish with butter and season lightly.
4. Layer potatoes, eggs, bacon, and cheese in bowls or hotel pans for self-service.
5. Serve with toast. Hold hot food at 135°F or above.
notes: Small-diced or par-cooked potatoes are required for the 30-minute window.

name: Baked Deluxe Rig with Garlic Bread and House Salad
ingredients:
8 lb | Dry rigatoni
2.5 gal | Hot house meat sauce
4 lb | Italian sausage, cooked and sliced or crumbled
3 lb | Pepperoni
5 lb | Shredded mozzarella
1 lb | Grated Romano
3 | full pans Garlic bread
1 | full pan House salad
1 qt | House dressing
method:
1. Boil the rigatoni in salted water until just short of al dente. Drain well.
2. While the pasta cooks, heat the meat sauce and cooked sausage to 165°F.
3. Combine the rigatoni with meat sauce, sausage, half the pepperoni, half the mozzarella, and half the Romano.
4. Divide into hot full hotel pans. Top with the remaining mozzarella, Romano, and pepperoni.
5. Bake at 425°F until the cheese is melted and the pans are bubbling, about 8 to 10 minutes. Heat garlic bread and toss the salad while the pasta bakes.
notes: Do not overcook the rigatoni before baking.

name: Chicken Patty Sandwiches with French Fries
ingredients:
45 | Breaded chicken patties
45 | Sandwich buns
15 lb | Frozen French fries
2 lb | Burger lettuce
3 lb | Sliced tomatoes
45 slices | American or provolone cheese, optional
As needed | Mayonnaise, mustard, pickles, salt, and fry seasoning
method:
1. Bake or fry the chicken patties until crisp and 165°F.
2. Fry the French fries in batches and season immediately.
3. Warm the buns. Set out lettuce, tomatoes, cheese, mayonnaise, mustard, and pickles.
4. Build the sandwiches or allow employees to add their own toppings. Serve one sandwich with fries per person.
notes: Run the patties in the oven while the fries cook. Keep cold toppings at 41°F or below until service.

name: Salisbury Steak with Onion Gravy Mashed Potatoes and Green Beans
ingredients:
12 lb | Ground beef
2 lb | Breadcrumbs
12 | Eggs
1 qt | Milk
6 oz | Worcestershire sauce
3 oz | Garlic powder
3 oz | Onion powder
4 lb | Sliced onions
2.5 gal | Prepared brown gravy
15 lb | Prepared mashed potatoes
3 No. 10 cans | Green beans, drained
As needed | Oil, butter, salt, and black pepper
method:
1. Mix the beef, breadcrumbs, eggs, milk, Worcestershire, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper. Form 45 even patties.
2. Cook the patties on the flat top in batches until browned and 155°F for ground beef. Transfer to hotel pans.
3. Sauté the onions until softened. Add the brown gravy and bring to a simmer, then pour over the patties.
4. Heat the mashed potatoes and green beans to 165°F for reheating. Finish both with butter and seasoning.
5. Hold the Salisbury steak and sides at 135°F or above until service.
notes: Pre-form the patties when possible. If the patties must be made at service time, start them first and heat the sides at the same time.

name: Scrambled Eggs with Home Fries and Toast
ingredients:
2 qt | Liquid eggs
8 lb | Potatoes, small dice or par-cooked
2 lb | Diced onions
30 slices | Toast
8 oz | Butter
As needed | Oil, pan spray, salt, black pepper, and paprika
method:
1. Start the home fries first. Cook the potatoes and onions on the flat top or in hot skillets with oil, salt, pepper, and paprika until browned and tender.
2. Cook the liquid eggs in greased hotel pans or in batches on the flat top. Stir gently and cook until set.
3. Finish the eggs with butter and adjust the seasoning.
4. Toast the bread close to service. Serve one portion of eggs with home fries and one slice of toast.
notes: Use small-diced or par-cooked potatoes to stay within the 30-minute window. Cook the potatoes and eggs at the same time.

name: Nashville Hot Chicken with Macaroni and Cheese Pickles and White Bread
ingredients:
40 pieces | Raw bone-in chicken pieces
1 gal | Buttermilk
5 lb | All-purpose flour
8 oz | Seasoned salt
3 oz | Paprika
2 oz each | Garlic powder and black pepper
As needed | Fryer oil
1 batch | Prepared Nashville Hot Chicken Sauce, separate recipe
4 lb dry | Elbow macaroni
1.5 gal | Hot prepared cheese sauce
60 slices | White bread, about 2 per person
2 qt | Dill pickle chips
method:
1. Soak or coat the chicken in buttermilk. Combine the flour, seasoned salt, paprika, garlic powder, and black pepper.
2. Dredge the chicken thoroughly in the seasoned flour. Stage the pieces by size so the fryer batches cook evenly.
3. Deep-fry the chicken in batches until crisp and every piece reaches 165°F. Drain briefly on racks.
4. Cook the macaroni while the chicken fries. Drain and fold it into the hot cheese sauce; hold at 135°F or above.
5. Whisk the prepared Nashville hot sauce and brush or ladle it over the hot chicken. Leave some pieces plain. Serve with pickles and white bread.
notes: Bread the chicken before the meal window when possible. Fry the largest pieces first. The Nashville hot sauce is maintained as a separate recipe and should be whisked before every use.

name: Breakfast Burritos with Eggs Potatoes Cheese and Salsa
ingredients:
30 | Large flour tortillas
2 qt | Liquid eggs
8 lb | Potatoes, small dice or par-cooked
2 lb | Shredded cheese
1.5 qt | Salsa
1 lb | Diced onions, optional
As needed | Oil, pan spray, salt, black pepper, and paprika
method:
1. Cook the potatoes and optional onions on the flat top with oil and seasoning until browned and tender.
2. Cook the liquid eggs in batches. Keep them soft enough that they do not dry out during assembly.
3. Warm the tortillas. Divide the potatoes, eggs, and cheese evenly among 30 tortillas.
4. Roll the burritos tightly and place them seam-side down in covered hotel pans. Hold only briefly.
5. Serve one burrito per person with salsa on the side.
notes: Use par-cooked potatoes to keep production under 30 minutes. Assemble close to service so the tortillas do not become wet.

name: Taco Tuesday with Spanish Rice and Refried Beans
ingredients:
10 lb | Ground beef or prepared taco meat
6 oz | Taco seasoning
2 cups | Water
60 | Taco shells or small tortillas
4 lb dry | Rice
As needed | Tomato sauce, stock, and seasoning for Spanish rice
2 No. 10 cans | Refried beans
3 lb | Shredded cheese
2 lb | Shredded lettuce
3 lb | Diced tomatoes
2 qt | Salsa
method:
1. Start the Spanish rice according to the house method. Heat the refried beans, stirring as needed.
2. Brown the ground beef on the flat top or in a tilt skillet. Drain excess fat.
3. Add the taco seasoning and water. Simmer until evenly seasoned and the liquid has reduced.
4. Warm the taco shells or tortillas. Set out the meat, cheese, lettuce, tomatoes, and salsa.
5. Plan on two tacos per person. Hold the taco meat, rice, and beans at 135°F or above.
notes: Keep the standard Taco Tuesday setup simple. Start the rice first and cook the taco meat while the rice and beans heat.

name: Bacon Egg and Cheese English Muffins with Breakfast Potatoes
ingredients:
30 | English muffins
2 qt | Liquid eggs
3 lb | Bacon
30 slices | American or provolone cheese
8 lb | Potatoes, small dice or par-cooked
1.5 lb | Diced onions
As needed | Oil, butter, pan spray, salt, black pepper, and paprika
method:
1. Cook the bacon on sheet pans or the flat top until crisp. Drain and hold warm.
2. Cook the potatoes and onions on the flat top until browned and tender.
3. Cook the liquid eggs in greased hotel pans or in batches on the flat top. Season lightly and portion into 30 servings.
4. Warm the English muffins. Build each sandwich with egg, bacon, and one slice of cheese.
5. Hold the sandwiches only long enough to melt the cheese. Serve with breakfast potatoes.
notes: Run the bacon, potatoes, and eggs at the same time. Do not assemble the sandwiches too early.

name: Cheeseburger Sliders with French Fries
ingredients:
6 lb | Ground beef
36 | Slider rolls
36 slices | American cheese
1 lb | Finely diced onions, optional
1 cup | Worcestershire sauce
10 lb | Frozen French fries
As needed | Salt, black pepper, ketchup, mustard, and pickles
method:
1. Press the ground beef in an even layer on greased sheet pans. Season with salt, pepper, Worcestershire, and optional onion.
2. Bake at high heat until browned and the beef reaches 155°F. Drain excess fat.
3. Cut the cooked beef to fit the connected slider rolls. Add cheese, replace the tops, and return briefly to the oven to melt.
4. Cut into 36 sliders. Fry the French fries in batches and season immediately.
5. Serve one slider per person with extras available, fries, pickles, ketchup, and mustard.
notes: Cooking the beef as a sheet-pan slab is faster than forming individual burgers. Build the sliders in connected sections, then cut after heating.

name: Bacon and Egg Breakfast Fried Rice
ingredients:
4 lb dry | Rice, cooked and chilled before service
2 qt | Liquid eggs
3 lb | Bacon, diced
3 lb | Frozen mixed vegetables
1.5 cups | Soy sauce
4 oz | Butter
As needed | Oil, garlic, black pepper, and sliced green onion
method:
1. Cook the bacon on the flat top or in a tilt skillet until crisp. Remove it and reserve a small amount of the rendered fat.
2. Scramble the liquid eggs in batches. Break them into bite-size pieces and set aside.
3. Cook the mixed vegetables in the bacon fat and oil. Add the cold rice and cook over high heat until hot.
4. Add the soy sauce, bacon, eggs, butter, garlic, and black pepper. Toss until evenly mixed and heated to 165°F.
5. Finish with sliced green onion if available and hold at 135°F or above.
notes: The rice must be cooked and chilled ahead. Cold rice fries quickly and stays separate; freshly cooked rice will make the dish wet.

name: BBQ Pulled Chicken Sandwiches with Baked Beans and French Fries
ingredients:
8 lb | Cooked pulled or chopped chicken
2 qt | BBQ sauce
30 | Sandwich buns
2 No. 10 cans | Prepared baked beans
10 lb | Frozen French fries
1 lb | Diced onion, optional
As needed | Oil, butter, salt, black pepper, and fry seasoning
method:
1. Combine the cooked chicken and BBQ sauce in a rondeau or hotel pan. Heat to 165°F, stirring as needed.
2. Heat the baked beans to 165°F for reheating. Add diced onion if desired.
3. Warm the buns briefly without drying them out.
4. Fry the French fries in batches and season immediately.
5. Portion about 4 ounces of BBQ chicken onto each bun and serve with baked beans and fries.
notes: Use safe cooked chicken or chicken trim when available. Keep the BBQ sauce controlled so the sandwiches do not become wet.

name: Belgian Waffles with Scrambled Eggs and Bacon
ingredients:
30 | Belgian waffles or 60 waffle halves
2 qt | Liquid eggs
3 lb | Bacon
1 qt | Pancake syrup
8 oz | Butter
As needed | Pan spray, salt, and black pepper
method:
1. Cook the bacon on sheet pans or the flat top until crisp. Drain and hold warm.
2. Heat the waffles in the oven or toaster until hot and lightly crisp. Do not stack them too early.
3. Cook the liquid eggs in greased hotel pans or in batches on the flat top. Season lightly.
4. Finish the eggs with butter and hold at 135°F or above.
5. Serve one waffle with scrambled eggs, bacon, butter, and syrup.
notes: Run the bacon, waffles, and eggs at the same time. Hold waffles uncovered or loosely covered so they do not steam.

name: Fish and Chips with Seasoned Corn and Tartar Sauce
ingredients:
36 | Breaded fish portions or fish patties
12 lb | Frozen French fries
2 No. 10 cans | Corn, drained
1.5 qt | Tartar sauce
8 oz | Butter
As needed | Fry seasoning, salt, black pepper, and lemon wedges
method:
1. Bake or fry the breaded fish according to the product directions until crisp and heated to 165°F.
2. Fry the French fries in batches and season immediately.
3. Heat the corn to 165°F for reheating. Finish with butter, salt, and black pepper.
4. Keep the fish and fries uncovered or lightly vented so the breading stays crisp.
5. Serve one fish portion per person with extras available, fries, corn, tartar sauce, and lemon if available.
notes: Use the breaded fish already in inventory. Time the final fish and fry batches as close to service as possible.

name: Buttermilk Pancakes with Scrambled Eggs and Bacon
ingredients:
90 | Medium pancakes, about 2 per person
1.8 gal | Prepared pancake batter
3 qt | Liquid eggs
5 lb | Bacon
1.5 qt | Pancake syrup
12 oz | Butter
As needed | Pan spray, salt, and black pepper
method:
1. Cook the bacon on sheet pans until crisp. Drain and hold warm.
2. Cook the pancakes in batches on a greased flat top, making about 90 medium pancakes.
3. Cook the liquid eggs in greased hotel pans or in batches on the flat top. Season lightly.
4. Hold pancakes covered only briefly so they stay soft without becoming wet.
5. Serve two pancakes with scrambled eggs, bacon, butter, and syrup.
notes: Run the bacon in the oven while the pancakes cook on the flat top and the eggs cook in hotel pans. Use the house scratch pancake batter.

name: Sausage and Peppers over Penne with Garlic Bread
ingredients:
10 lb | Italian sausage, cooked and sliced or crumbled
8 lb dry | Penne pasta
5 lb | Bell peppers, sliced
3 lb | Onions, sliced
2.5 gal | Hot house marinara or meat sauce
1 lb | Grated Romano
3 full pans | Garlic bread
As needed | Oil, salt, black pepper, and garlic
method:
1. Bring the pasta water to a boil. Cook the penne until just tender, then drain well.
2. While the pasta cooks, sauté the peppers and onions in oil until softened but not mushy.
3. Add the fully cooked sausage and hot sauce. Bring to a simmer and heat to 165°F.
4. Combine the penne with enough sauce to coat it, or hold the pasta and sausage mixture separately for service.
5. Heat the garlic bread. Finish the pasta with Romano and hold at 135°F or above.
notes: Use fully cooked sausage and hot sauce to meet the 30-minute target. Start the pasta water immediately and do not overcook the penne.

name: Loaded Breakfast Potatoes with Eggs Bacon Cheese and Toast
ingredients:
15 lb | Potatoes, small dice or par-cooked
3 qt | Liquid eggs
5 lb | Bacon, diced
4 lb | Shredded cheese
3 lb | Diced onions
45 slices | Toast
As needed | Oil, butter, pan spray, salt, black pepper, and paprika
method:
1. Cook the bacon on sheet pans or the flat top until crisp. Drain and reserve.
2. Cook the potatoes and onions on the flat top with oil, salt, pepper, and paprika until browned and tender.
3. Cook the liquid eggs in greased hotel pans or in batches on the flat top.
4. Layer the potatoes, eggs, bacon, and cheese in hotel pans. Heat briefly to melt the cheese.
5. Toast the bread and serve one loaded breakfast-potato portion with one slice of toast.
notes: Small-diced or par-cooked potatoes are required for the 30-minute window. Serve from hotel pans to speed up service for 45 people.

name: Ground Beef Stroganoff over Rigatoni with Green Beans
ingredients:
12 lb | Ground beef
4 lb | Sliced onions
4 lb | Sliced mushrooms
2.5 gal | Prepared beef gravy
3 qt | Sour cream
8 oz | Worcestershire sauce
3 oz | Garlic powder
8 lb dry | Rigatoni
3 No. 10 cans | Green beans, drained
As needed | Oil, butter, salt, and black pepper
method:
1. Bring the pasta water to a boil. Cook the rigatoni until just tender, then drain well.
2. Brown the ground beef on the flat top or in a tilt skillet until it reaches 155°F. Drain excess fat.
3. Sauté the onions and mushrooms until softened. Add the beef gravy and Worcestershire and bring to a simmer.
4. Return the beef to the sauce. Remove from direct high heat and stir in the sour cream without boiling. Heat the green beans to 165°F and finish with butter and seasoning.
5. Serve the stroganoff over rigatoni with green beans. Hold hot foods at 135°F or above.
notes: Start the pasta water first. Use hot prepared gravy and add the sour cream after the sauce comes off high heat so it stays smooth.
